admission.justification: A future test cleanup must not silently replace real public-answer coverage with lighter synthetic answers while retaining its provenance claim.

applicability: The four-tree reviewer real-captures boundary chosen in MIK-R57@v2 appendix83/151 and rule6.
conditions: Retained mounted controls load the actual captured public-response JSON and its recorded request identity; changed fixtures must have their own truthful capture provenance.
exclusions: The helper does not authenticate every historical capture hash, prove a native producer run, or prohibit explicitly declared synthetic unit tests elsewhere.
statement: Captured actual public answers remain test data without synthetic trimming to meet a preferred fixture weight.
